name: Largeleaf grass of Parnassus
desc: Largeleaf grass of Parnassus (Parnassia grandifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 22 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Parnassia grandifolia, also known as bigleaf grass of Parnassus, is a flowering herbaceous plant of the family Celastraceae.
